campaign.name: AURA Sustainable Sneaker — Seed Demo
campaign.goal: Launch an eco-friendly sneaker brand with a 30-second premium Instagram Reel.

brand: Walk lighter on the planet. Crafted from recycled ocean plastic, designed for the city.
script: Sustainability meets style. Four scenes: opening product hero, lifestyle in the city, material close-up, closing brand stamp.

scenes.description: Opening — premium product hero on a neutral stone surface, soft golden-hour rim light.
scenes.imagePrompt: A single premium sustainable sneaker on a clean stone surface, soft golden hour light, editorial product photography.
scenes.caption: Walk lighter on the planet.

scenes.description: Lifestyle — a runner crossing a city crosswalk at dawn, motion blur on the feet.
scenes.imagePrompt: A person running across a city crosswalk at dawn, motion blur on the feet, shallow depth of field.
scenes.caption: Made for the city.

scenes.description: Material close-up — macro shot of the recycled-mesh upper texture, shallow depth of field.
scenes.imagePrompt: Macro close-up of a recycled mesh sneaker upper, shallow depth of field, soft diffused studio light.
scenes.caption: Crafted from recycled ocean plastic.

scenes.description: Closing — brand stamp over a wide hero shot of the sneaker, premium feel.
scenes.imagePrompt: Wide hero shot of the sustainable sneaker with the brand logo watermark, premium editorial composition.
scenes.caption: AURA. Walk lighter.
